title: Tom Albert's violin lessons with Jimmy Palao and teaching himself cornet
summary: Tom took violin lessons twice a week from Jimmy Palao. When the violin got too slow he bought an ABC book, learned scales and taught himself cornet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
